License"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What this is"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**dsh-research-plugins** gives your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent three research superpowers it does "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"not have out of the box:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Web search** via the Tavily Search API — a settings toggle that swaps the built-in DeepSeek sear"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ch for Tavily, with keyless search support.
- **Web scraping & crawling** via the Firecrawl MCP serv"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"er — scrape, crawl, map, and search the open web inside tool calls.
- **Up-to-date library docs** vi"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"a the Context7 MCP server — on-demand documentation and code examples for any library or framework."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Everything is delivered as drop-in **DSH plugins** — no vendor lock-in, no forks, just a `dsh plugin"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"is delivered as drop-in **DSH plugins** — no vendor lock-in, no forks, just a `dsh plugin add` away."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Package | What it adds |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| `@pymodel/dsh-tavily` | Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle, keyless searc"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"h) + a Tavily MCP bridge (`tavily_search` / `tavily_extract` keyless; `tavily_crawl` / `tavily_map` "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"/ `tavily_research` with a key) |
| `dsh-mcp-firecrawl` | Firecrawl MCP: keyless `search` / `scrape`"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" / `parse`; full tool surface with an API key |
| `dsh-mcp-context7` | Context7 MCP: `mcp__context7_"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"_*` up-to-date library docs and code examples |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Each package installs independently into a DSH profile:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Or follow GitHub (this repo, latest commits):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## API keys"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The MCP bridges use the harness's shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. They read keys from the **l"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"aunch environment** (a real env var, the project `.env`, or `$DSH_HOME/.env`) — not from `$DSH_HOME/"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" (a real env var, the project `.env`, or `$DSH_HOME/.env`) — not from `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Plugin | Env var | Required | Endpoint |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `dsh-tavily` (MCP part) | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | no (keyless MCP: search + extract; crawl / map / rese"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"arch need a key) | `https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/` |
| `dsh-mcp-firecrawl` | `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` | no "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"(keyless: search/scrape/parse; full surface with a key) | `https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp` |
| `ds"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"h-mcp-context7` | `CONTEXT7_API_KEY` | no (keyless works) | `https://mcp.context7.com/mcp` |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Keys are sent as an `Authorization: Bearer` header at load time — never in the URL and never in plai"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"n YAML. Without a key the bridges run in each vendor's documented keyless mode (`X-Tavily-Access-Mod"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"e: keyless` for Tavily), so every row works out of the box. A key added to `.env` needs a `dsh web` "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ss` for Tavily), so every row works out of the box. A key added to `.env` needs a `dsh web` restart."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Already have your own MCP row?"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The bundles insert loader entries `mcp-tavily`, `mcp-firecrawl` and `mcp-context7`. If your profile'"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"s `cordis.patch.yml` also inserts one of those ids, DSH refuses to boot (`duplicate loader entry id:"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" mcp-tavily`) and DSH Desktop opens Safe Mode. A second row under another id with the same `serverNa"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"me` fails too (`serverName "tavily" is already in use`)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Delete your own row, or keep your settings (a proxy or gateway URL, say) by turning it into an overr"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ide of the plugin's row.
